text:
maya: CI red on PR #482 — pre-commit step failed and left the whole pipeline red. looks like mypy + rustfmt noise. job: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/482
ci-bot: build #482 · precommit (lint) · FAILED · exit code 1
arjun: can you paste the failing mypy snippet? happy to bisect if it's a types change. :eyes:
maya: paste below — this is from tox:typecheck run:
```
file: inference/kvcache/store.py:123: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "None", variable has type "str")  [assignment]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 512 source files)
```
sasha: rustfmt also flagged a bunch of unrelated files in workspace. my local `cargo fmt` fixed it but i'm worried about line endings. which pre-commit hooks are running?
leslie: our pre-commit config updated black/rustfmt hooks last week, might be the suspect. also seen flaky hook failures when CI uses older caches.
jeff: can someone do a rerun first (flaky runner) while we bisect? if it passes we can avoid manual changes. /retest
ci-bot: rebuild triggered by jeff — https://ci.redwood.example/builds/482/retry-1
arjun: starting a quick bisect locally: first check main@3f2b -> HEAD. if it points to .pre-commit-config.yaml bump we can pin. i'll report back in ~20m.
maya: thanks. if bisect finds the mypy strictness change, we can either add a narrow fix in code (Optional check) or add a targeted ignore in mypy.ini for that module while we roll back the hook.
sasha: tip: running `git config core.autocrlf false` then `pre-commit run --all-files` matched CI for me. sharing quick command: `python -m pip install pre-commit==2.21.0 && pre-commit run --all-files`
leslie: rerun finished: precommit now PASSED but typecheck still FAILS. new mypy snippet:
```
inference/serve/runner.py:87: error: "Optional[str]" not assignable to "str"  [assignment]
```
arjun: that's consistent — looks like a strictness bump in typeshed or plugin. i'll open a tiny PR to guard the assignment with an `if x is None: x = ""` or annotate Optional and narrow. assigning to self to keep change minimal.
maya: great — once you draft the PR ping here, i'll rebase and run full pipeline. thanks all :thumbsup:
